title: Moratorium research decision file
description: Output contract for a research pass over a set of inventory rows. One file per state per pass. Consumed by scripts/apply_research.py, which never edits the inventory from prose.

state_abbrev.description: USPS abbreviation of the state this packet covers.

researched_as_of.description: Reference date the researcher treated as 'today'. All 'still active' claims are relative to this date.

researcher.description: Model or person that produced this file.

new_candidates.description: Moratorium instruments discovered during this pass that are NOT already in the inventory.

url.description: Direct URL to the document or page consulted.

document_date.description: Date on the document itself (ISO where known).

source_type.description: Primary-source types rank above 'news'. A status change should rest on a primary source where one exists.

supports.description: What specific claim this source establishes.

quote.description: Short verbatim excerpt establishing the claim, where available.

from.description: Existing value, copied verbatim from the inventory.

reason.description: Why the change is warranted, referencing the evidence.

moratorium_id.description: Primary key from the inventory. Must already exist.

outcome.description: confirmed_unchanged: current record verified accurate as of researched_as_of. status_changed: enacted_status and/or dates move. corrected: a non-status factual error fixed. unresolvable: no adequate source found; record left alone.

new_enacted_status.description: Required when outcome=status_changed. Must be a codebook value.

changes.description: Column-name -> field_change. Only columns present in the inventory CSV.

verify_resolutions.description: One entry per [VERIFY ...] marker addressed in this pass.

resolution.description: confirmed/corrected mean the marker is removed from the field text. still_unverifiable keeps it.

note.description: What was found, or why it remains unverifiable.

confidence.description: Researcher confidence in this decision. Below 0.4 is treated as unresolvable at merge time.

evidence.description: At least one source. outcome=unresolvable may cite the portals checked.

candidate.description: A newly discovered instrument. Deliberately mirrors the inventory columns so apply_research.py can construct a row.

date_enacted.description: Free text with provenance, per the codebook.

date_enacted_iso.description: YYYY-MM-DD / YYYY-MM / YYYY, or empty if pending.
